question: Why did a later delete stage stay armed when the stage directory already held removed-0?
allowedInputs: boot/freeldr/freeldr/lib/fs/ntfs.c NtfsMoveFile returns false when NtfsLookupMft already finds the destination path.

Reported: dir of C:\VerOS\System32\config\sysupdate\stage listed removed-0 and removed-1 from an earlier boot, and a reboot left C:\VerOS\hold\victim.txt in place with the manifest still starting update-stage-1. After the pass chose a free slot, that directory was empty, removed-2 was the 2-byte file, and the manifest started update-spent-1.
